universal.title: Found a cool sticker
universal.body: Lying on the ground, corner barely scuffed. Someone's loss is your gain.

universal.title: Lot chatter
universal.body: Two people near you are deep in debate about tonight's opener. You listen in.

universal.title: Found a lighter
universal.body: A bright green Bic, half full. Somebody's gonna be missing that.

universal.title: Wook trade offer
universal.body: A wook sidles up with something in a bandana. 'No cash, just vibes — wanna trade?' You politely decline.

universal.title: Found $5 in a pocket
universal.body: Old jacket, old pocket, old five. Still spends.

universal.title: Good energy in the spot
universal.body: Can't explain it. The vibe here is just right. You linger a minute.

park.title: Hacky sack circle
park.body: The circle opens up and waves you in. You hang for a few kicks.

park.title: Grilled cheese out of a cooler
park.body: Guy's running a whole operation from the back of a Honda Civic. Two bucks, two slices.

park.title: Sketchy offer
park.body: Some guy slides up quiet. 'You look like you could use this.' Hard to say no.

diner.title: Waitress heard something
diner.body: She leans in while refilling coffee — 'heard someone at the counter talking about tonight's show.' Good signs.

diner.title: Rowdy table
diner.body: The booth next to you is extremely loud the whole time. You finish your coffee faster than planned.

diner.title: Short stack special
diner.body: Still on the board, still $8. You order without hesitation.

record_store.title: Bootleg find
record_store.body: A live {bandName} recording, no label, handwritten dates on the sleeve. Someone loved this band.

record_store.title: The clerk knows everything
record_store.body: You ask about the show tonight. Twenty minutes later you know the full history of the venue and three bands you've never heard of.

record_store.title: Ticket in the stacks
record_store.body: Tucked inside a stack of {bandName} records — a loose ticket. Not gonna question it.

hotel.title: Loose cash in the nightstand
hotel.body: Last guest left a rumpled ten and a prayer card. Finders keepers in this economy.

hotel.title: Maid left extras
hotel.body: Extra granola bar, two bottles of water, and a can from the cart. You'll take it.

hotel.title: Noisy neighbors
hotel.body: Party going until 3am next door. Thin walls, thin patience.

friends_house.title: Friend's fridge came through
friends_house.body: Someone's roommate stocked up. Two cold ones with your name on them.

friends_house.title: Impromptu jam session
friends_house.body: Someone broke out a guitar. Next thing you know an hour's gone by.

friends_house.title: Someone got into your snacks
friends_house.body: You left your bag in the kitchen. Rookie mistake. Half your food's gone.
